series_config.relation_to_earlier_series: Replaces usability-3build-20261110-r2 before any measured run, with the same builds, tasks, prompts, repetitions, model and budget; only checker, reset and request-pacing fixes differ. The two-build series (manifest e27c0aac..., nonce 007817e94cfb) stays on the record as it is.
series_config.reporting: Each task set is reported on its own, per build; the two sets are never added into one total (bench/analyze.py).
series_config.supersedes: series usability-3build-20261110-r2 (manifest 3e94f30e1a7073cfced13ca237931ec302f92e03f722bf7c82a6111d264d9c6b, frozen 2026-11-10T22:30:58Z): never measured; its dry run stopped at 17 of 36 (harness hourly request budget) and showed one more checker defect (task k FunnelsFilter defaults), fixed in 109070e. It in turn superseded usability-3build-20261110 (never measured).
series_config.title: PostHog MCP: baseline vs fixed vs usability research build, two task sets

task_sets._doc: Which benchmark task belongs to which task set (AUDIT_SOP Phase 4, 'Two task sets, always reported separately'). bench/_make_plan.py and bench/analyze.py read this file; every task file also states its set on its second line.

friction-derived.description: Built on 2026-11-10 from the jobs of the friction session (FRICTION-REPORT-20261110), AFTER the usability changes were designed. It exercises what those changes target and therefore favours the usability build by construction; it is never pooled with the pre-registered set.

pre-registered.description: The fair test. Written and frozen on 2026-11-10 (first freeze f9e60755, then e27c0aac), before the usability change list existed. Prompts and checker criteria unchanged since then.
